aliases: the strange, pale girl with the Goldilocks curls and frilly white dress
the strange, pale girl with the Goldilocks curls and frilly white dress
identity_phases.name: Esther

grounded_facts: Kate gives Yolanda activity books and a 'Travel Turtle' for the upcoming trip.
Kate gives Yolanda activity books and a 'Travel Turtle' for the trip tomorrow, which excites her.
memories.memory_text: I saw Kate give Yolanda a bag with activity books and a 'Travel Turtle' for the trip tomorrow, and I could tell Yolanda was really excited about it.

grounded_facts: John notices Esther's sophisticated paintings among children's crude artwork and follows her humming to the art room.
memories.memory_text: I was in the art room, painting, when I noticed someone had followed my humming. I saw John stop in the hallway, looking at my paintings among the others.

grounded_facts: John expresses admiration for Esther's paintings, calling them remarkable.
memories.memory_text: John told me he thought my paintings were remarkable, and I remember feeling that he really saw me.

grounded_facts: Esther explains that her paintings are imaginative stories, using the lion painting to express turning sadness into hope, revealing emotional depth and resilience.
Esther tells John that people should turn bad experiences into something good, revealing emotional maturity.
memories.memory_text: I explained to John that my paintings are like imaginative stories, and I told him that people should try to turn the bad things that happen to them into something good—like how I turn sadness into hope through my art.

grounded_facts: Instead of shaking Kate's hand, Esther presses it to her cheek and says 'Motta...'
When introduced to Kate, Esther does not shake her hand but instead lovingly presses it to her cheek, saying 'Motta...'
memories.memory_text: I didn't shake Kate's hand like usual; instead, I pressed it to my cheek and said 'Motta...' because I felt something special in that moment.

grounded_facts: Kate and John visit the home for girls to spend time with Yolanda before she joins their family tomorrow.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Kate and John came to visit Yolanda today because she’s going home with them tomorrow, and Sister Abigail said it was wonderful.

grounded_facts: Sister Abigail interrupts and dismisses Esther's offer to paint for Kate and John, redirecting them to focus on Yolanda's adoption.
Sister Abigail interrupts Esther's attempt to connect with Kate and John, telling her they don't have time.
memories.memory_text: I offered to paint a picture for Kate and John, but Sister Abigail interrupted me and told me they didn't have time, then took them away.

grounded_facts: Kate, Abigail, and John notice Esther peering from around a corner in the hallway during a hug.
memories.memory_text: I was peering from around the corner in the hallway, watching them hug.

grounded_facts: Kate asks Sister Abigail to interpret what Esther said.
memories.memory_text: I remember Kate asking Sister Abigail what I had said.

grounded_facts: Sister Abigail explains that 'motta' is Russian for 'mother' after Kate asks about Esther's utterance.
memories.memory_text: I was told that 'motta' means 'mother' in Russian after Kate asked about my utterance.

grounded_facts: A routine activity in the chapel where Esther assists a nun in cleaning the sanctuary during the day.
memories.memory_text: I was helping the nun clean the sanctuary during the day, happily doing my part.

grounded_facts: Esther shows affection and connection by waving at Kate and John, who reciprocate, indicating a growing emotional bond.
memories.memory_text: I looked up from what I was doing and waved at Kate and John, and they waved back at me.

grounded_facts: Esther initiates a friendly wave toward Kate and John, who wave back, reinforcing mutual affection.
memories.memory_text: I looked up from my work and waved at Kate and John, and I saw them wave back, which made me feel close to them.

grounded_facts: Sister Abigail tells Kate to call if she ever needs anything.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sister Abigail tell Kate to call if she ever needed anything, her voice kind and steady as we stood by the car.

grounded_facts: Esther tugs on Kate's arm and urges her to get into the car, showing eagerness to leave.
memories.memory_text: I tugged on Kate's arm and said, 'Come on! Let's go!' because I couldn't wait to get in the car and start going with her.

grounded_facts: Rate replies to Sister Abigail's offer of help on behalf of the departing group.
memories.memory_text: I heard Rate reply 'We will' to Sister Abigail, speaking for all of us as we were about to leave.

grounded_facts: A formal send-off as Esther leaves the home for girls with Kate, involving farewells and well-wishes.
Esther departs from the home for girls with Kate, marking a transition from institutional care to a new living situation.
memories.memory_text: I walked out of the home with Kate holding my hand, and Sister Abigail saw us off as John put my suitcase and paintings in the car; I waved goodbye, feeling the start of something new as we left the place behind.

grounded_facts: After the car departs, Sister Abigail's initial happiness turns to quiet unease.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Sister Abigail's smile fade after the car pulled away, and she seemed vaguely troubled as we drove off, though she had been happy at first.

grounded_facts: Kate physically guides Esther to make the correct sign for the letter 'T'
memories.memory_text: I made the sign for 'T' wrong, and Kate showed me the right way by making the sign herself, so I could see my mistake and fix it.

grounded_facts: Esther initially missigns the letter 'T' in her name but is corrected by Kate and successfully corrects herself.
memories.memory_text: I tried to sign my name, but I got the 'T' wrong at first; after Kate showed me, I corrected myself and signed E-S-T-H-E-R properly.

grounded_facts: Esther notices the colored leaves outside and comments on their beauty using the word 'motta'
memories.memory_text: I looked outside and saw the colorful leaves, and I said to Kate, 'It's so beautiful, motta.'

grounded_facts: An informal language lesson taking place in the car where Kate teaches Esther sign language and corrects her spoken terms
memories.memory_text: I was in the car with Kate, learning how to sign my name and other words, and she helped me say things the right way.

grounded_facts: Kate informs Esther that 'motta' should be replaced with 'mommy' or 'Mont' in their context
Kate tells Esther to use 'mommy' or 'Mont' instead of 'motta'
memories.memory_text: Kate told me that I should say 'mommy' or 'Mont' instead of 'motta'.

grounded_facts: Daniel sees Esther for the first time and is visibly shocked by her appearance.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Daniel standing there, visibly shocked when he saw me for the first time, staring at the strange, pale girl in the frilly white dress.

grounded_facts: Esther uses sign language to greet Max and introduce herself.
Esther signs to Max to introduce herself, marking her first interaction with a family member using sign language.
memories.memory_text: I signed my name to Max, saying 'Hello, Max. My name is Esther,' and it was the first time I used sign language to introduce myself to someone in the family.

grounded_facts: Kate embraces Max and kisses him, expressing affection after separation.
memories.memory_text: I saw Kate embrace Max and kiss him, and then Max gave her an excited smile after they were reunited.

grounded_facts: The group arrives at the Coleman family home during the day, initiating a family reunion.
Esther arrives at the Coleman residence with Kate and the others, marking her first appearance at the family home.
memories.memory_text: I arrived at the Coleman family home with Kate and the others, and I remember being amazed by how beautiful the house looked as my mouth practically hung open in awe. Max ran out to meet us, and Kate hugged him tightly before taking our hands and leading us up to the house.

grounded_facts: Esther observes that Max wears a hearing aid, indicating her attention to sensory details and possible implications for communication.
memories.memory_text: I noticed that Max wears a hearing aid when I saw him.

grounded_facts: Esther performs a polite curtsy when meeting Doris, which is received warmly.
Esther surprises everyone by giving Doris a perfect little curtsy upon meeting her.
memories.memory_text: I gave Doris a polite curtsy when we met, and I could see it surprised everyone, but it felt right to greet her that way.

grounded_facts: A gathering where Esther is introduced to Doris and Daniel, part of a family reunion or visit.
memories.memory_text: I was introduced to Grandma Doris and then met our son Daniel during a family gathering.

grounded_facts: Esther smiles and offers her hand to Daniel, who reluctantly shakes it.
Esther extends her hand to Daniel in greeting; he reluctantly accepts.
memories.memory_text: I smiled and offered my hand to Daniel, and after a moment, he reluctantly shook it.

grounded_facts: A family-led tour of the Coleman residence for Esther, serving as her formal introduction to the household space.
memories.memory_text: The family led me on a tour of the house, showing me around my new home, with Kate and the others following closely behind as I explored.

grounded_facts: Esther walks through the Coleman residence, expressing awe at its size and luxury, marking her introduction to her new living environment.
memories.memory_text: I walked through the house, amazed by how big and luxurious everything felt, and I remember saying, 'Everything's so big,' as I took in my new surroundings.

grounded_facts: Esther becomes aware of Daniel's critical comment about her clothing but chooses to conceal her reaction.
memories.memory_text: I overheard Daniel's comment about my clothes, but I pretended I didn't hear it.

grounded_facts: Daniel whispers to John, though audibly, criticizing Esther's clothing, introducing social tension.
Daniel makes a critical comment about Esther's clothing while speaking to John, though not discreetly.
memories.memory_text: I overheard Daniel whisper to John about why I was dressed like this, though he meant for it to be heard, and I pretended I didn't notice.

grounded_facts: Kate attempts to redirect Esther's attention after Daniel's comment by offering to show her bedroom.
memories.memory_text: Kate told me she would show me my room, trying to shift my attention after Daniel's remark.

grounded_facts: Esther secretly observes and evaluates Daniel as they go upstairs, indicating growing wariness.
memories.memory_text: I watched Daniel carefully as we went upstairs, sizing him up without letting him notice.

grounded_facts: Esther tells Kate she loves her, but corrects a mispronounced name, showing affection with a notable slip.
Esther accidentally calls Kate 'Monmiy' instead of 'Motta', indicating a possible confusion or emotional association with someone named Monmiy.
memories.memory_text: I told Kate I loved her, but I slipped and said 'Monmiy' instead of 'Motta'—I caught myself and meant to say the right name.

grounded_facts: Kate responds to Esther's declaration by reciprocating love.
memories.memory_text: I heard Kate say 'I love you, too, sweetie' after I told her I loved her.

grounded_facts: Esther tightly hugs John when he leans in for a kiss.
memories.memory_text: When John leaned in to kiss me goodnight, I hugged him tightly.

grounded_facts: Kate and John tuck Esther into bed, exchange affection, and prepare her for sleep.
memories.memory_text: I was in bed and Mom and Dad tucked me in, kissed me, and got ready to turn off the light and leave my room.

grounded_facts: Esther, Max, Kate, and possibly others gather for breakfast, during which Daniel prepares to leave for his soccer game.
memories.memory_text: I was eating breakfast with Max while someone poured our juice.

grounded_facts: Kate expresses encouragement and love to Daniel as he leaves for his soccer game.
memories.memory_text: I heard Kate tell Daniel 'Good luck, I love you' as he was leaving for his soccer game.

grounded_facts: Daniel, wearing his soccer uniform, departs the house for a soccer game, receiving encouragement from Kate.
memories.memory_text: I saw Daniel rush in wearing his soccer uniform, and I heard Kate tell him 'Good luck, I love you' before he said 'Love you, too' and left.

grounded_facts: John kisses Kate as he follows Daniel out of the house.
memories.memory_text: I saw John follow Daniel out and kiss Kate on his way.

grounded_facts: John tells Kate he will call to inform her who won the soccer game.
memories.memory_text: I heard John say he would call to inform Kate who won the soccer game.

grounded_facts: A scheduled soccer game that Daniel is attending, which prompts family farewells and John's plan to report the outcome.
memories.memory_text: I remember Daniel leaving for a soccer game, and later John said he would call to let Kate know who won.

grounded_facts: Esther questions whether the wallpaper borders were picked for a younger child, suggesting they are inappropriate for her, which momentarily unsettles Kate.
memories.memory_text: I asked Kate if she picked the wallpaper borders for a younger child, maybe Yolanda, because they didn't feel right for me, and I saw her get startled before she apologized and said she’d get something just for me.

grounded_facts: Kate and Esther spend time decorating Esther's bedroom, including hanging paintings and selecting wallpaper borders.
memories.memory_text: I helped Kate decorate my room, pinning up my favorite paintings while she laid out wallpaper border samples, and I remember her noticing the Gothic mansion in my artwork.

grounded_facts: Kate observes that the same Gothic mansion appears in multiple older paintings by Esther, prompting her to ask if it is a real place.
memories.memory_text: I was pinning up my paintings when Kate noticed the same Gothic mansion in several of my older works and asked me if it's a real place.

grounded_facts: Esther describes a fictional haunted castle where a beautiful princess is rescued after years of sorrow, indicating her emotional investment in redemptive, romantic narratives.
memories.memory_text: I described my haunted castle to Kate, where a beautiful princess was locked away and so sad that her tears filled the moat, until a handsome prince swam across and rescued her.

grounded_facts: After telling her fantasy story, Esther smiles and asks Kate if she also likes happy endings, inviting emotional alignment.
memories.memory_text: I smiled and asked Kate if she likes happy endings too, because I wanted to know if she felt the same way I do.

grounded_facts: Kate takes Esther and other girls to the shopping mall to buy clothes, visiting a clothing store where they browse children's apparel.
memories.memory_text: I went with Kate and the other girls to the mall, where she showed me flower-embroidered jeans and said they were cute, but I told her that doesn’t mean I have to look like a boy.

grounded_facts: Esther refuses to accept the flower-embroidered jeans Kate picked, expressing dislike for jeans and resistance to gendered clothing expectations.
memories.memory_text: I told Kate that jeans are ugly and I don't want to look like a boy, even if they're supposed to be cute or practical for playing outside.

grounded_facts: Esther becomes distracted by a pet store display of tropical fish illuminated under black light and presses her nose against the glass, indicating fascination.
memories.memory_text: I saw something glowing in the window of a pet store and couldn't help but stop—I pressed my nose against the glass to get a closer look at the tropical fish lit up in bright colors under the black light.

grounded_facts: Kate taps Max's shoulder and signs a suggestion that Max should show Esther Hodgepodge when they return home.
memories.memory_text: I saw Kate tap Max's shoulder and sign something to her, and I gave them a curious look.

grounded_facts: After hearing about Hodgepodge, Esther asks what it is, showing interest in learning more.
memories.memory_text: I asked what Hodgepodge was because I didn't know and wanted to learn more.

grounded_facts: Kate signs to Max, suggesting that she show Esther Hodgepodge when they get home, initiating a plan for future interaction.
memories.memory_text: I heard Kate tell Max that she should show me Hodgepodge when we get home.

grounded_facts: A moment where Max shows off her responsibility in caring for her pet hamster Hodges, with Kate supervising interaction from Esther.
memories.memory_text: I knelt in front of Hodges' cage for a closer look, and I saw Max beam proudly when Kate said she takes care of him all by herself.

grounded_facts: Kate allows Esther to pet the hamster but imposes a safety rule about not releasing it without adult supervision.
Esther is permitted to pet the hamster Hodges under the condition that she does not let him out of the cage without adult supervision.
memories.memory_text: I asked if I could pet Hodges, and Kate said yes but told me I have to promise not to let him out of his cage unless an adult is there to hold him.

grounded_facts: Esther and Max exchange a smile while jointly stroking the hamster, indicating shared joy and bonding.
memories.memory_text: I shared a smile with Max while we stroked Hodges together, feeling a warm sense of connection and joy.

grounded_facts: Kate and Doris are preparing food for a barbecue while observing the children playing outside.
memories.memory_text: I remember watching Kate and Doris in the kitchen while Max and I played horseshoes in the backyard, laughing in our matching sundresses.

grounded_facts: Kate reveals her plan to start teaching piano lessons from home instead of returning to her previous job at Yale.
memories.memory_text: I heard Kate say she wasn't going back to Yale—she was going to teach piano lessons from home instead.

grounded_facts: Doris presses Kate about her job prospects, showing subtle judgment about her leaving Yale.
memories.memory_text: I sensed Doris was judging Kate when she asked if they'd take her back at Yale, and later made a comment about it being a shame it took something serious for Kate to get help.

grounded_facts: Esther unwraps a book of sign language and expresses excitement, learning how to sign 'thank you'.
memories.memory_text: I unwrapped the sign language book and got so excited—I told everyone it was perfect, and I immediately asked how to sign 'thank you' so I could use it right away.

grounded_facts: After learning the sign for 'thank you', Esther turns and signs it to Max.
memories.memory_text: After Kate showed me how to sign 'thank you', I turned and signed it to Max, and he signed back 'YOU'RE WELCOME,' which made me feel happy that I could thank him in a new way.

grounded_facts: Esther opens a large gift labeled 'FROM DADDY' and discovers a portable easel and new painting supplies, which delights her.
memories.memory_text: I opened a big gift from Daddy and found a portable easel and new painting supplies, and I was so happy.

grounded_facts: Esther sticks her tongue out at Daniel over John's shoulder, mocking his failed attempt to gain attention.
After receiving attention from John, Esther looks at Daniel and sticks her tongue out at him, signaling rivalry or triumph.
memories.memory_text: After getting attention from John, I looked at Daniel over his shoulder and stuck my tongue out at him, mocking him for not being noticed.

grounded_facts: Daniel repeatedly calls out to John to watch his cannonball, but is only given a distracted glance.
Daniel attempts to gain his father's attention before performing a cannonball into the pool, but John remains focused on Esther, making the act go unacknowledged.
memories.memory_text: I saw Daniel calling out to his dad, trying to get him to watch his cannonball, but John barely looked away from me, so I just stuck my tongue out at Daniel over his shoulder.

grounded_facts: A small nighttime gathering at the Coleman residence pool where Esther opens presents, receives gifts, and is celebrated by the family.
memories.memory_text: I remember the night gathering by the pool where I opened presents and everyone celebrated me, with Daniel splashing around and doing a big cannonball later, though I was more focused on my gifts and getting John's attention.

grounded_facts: John and Kate orchestrate a surprise by covering Esther's eyes and leading her into the room to reveal the fish tank
A planned moment where John and Kate reveal the fish tank to Esther in her bedroom at night
memories.memory_text: I remember John covering my eyes from behind while Kate led me by the hand into the darkened room, and then Kate asking if I was ready before John uncovered my eyes.

grounded_facts: Esther sees the fish tank for the first time and is filled with awe, becoming entranced by its effects under the black light.
memories.memory_text: I stopped short in awe when I saw the fish tank, and I knelt before it, completely entranced as I turned the black light on and off, marveling at how it made my dress glow and the colors in my paintings come alive.

grounded_facts: Esther and Max are playing a board game together in the family room.
memories.memory_text: I was playing a board game with Max in the family room when Kate came in and interrupted us.

grounded_facts: Kate directly questions Max about the disappearance of the pearls and their reappearance in Max's room and on T.J.'s neck.
Kate confronts Max about finding the pearls in her room and suspects her of placing them around T.J.'s neck.

memories.memory_text: I promised John and Kate that I would hold my sister's hand as we went inside the haunted maze without any adults.

grounded_facts: Esther leads Max through a haunted maze at night, where they encounter staged scares designed to startle visitors.
memories.memory_text: I led Max through the dark, winding corridors of the haunted maze, keeping us both on track despite the spooky turns.

grounded_facts: Esther's calm and amused reaction to a jump scare helps Max overcome her fear, leading to shared laughter.
Max initially feels scared in the haunted maze but becomes less afraid after observing Esther's fearless reaction to a rubber-masked ghoul, eventually laughing together with her.
memories.memory_text: When a rubber-masked ghoul jumped out and scared Max, I laughed at it, and I saw her realize it wasn't real—soon we were both giggling at the cheesy spooks trying to startle us.

grounded_facts: Max initiates a game of hide and seek by running away from Esther into the crowd.
memories.memory_text: I suggested to Max, 'Let's play hide and seek. You go first,' and then he ran off into the crowd.

grounded_facts: When asked about Max's whereabouts, Esther points in the wrong direction, misleading the search.
memories.memory_text: I pointed the wrong way when they asked where Max was.

grounded_facts: A family outing to a nighttime carnival where the girls play games and become separated.
memories.memory_text: I watched the crowd with a calm smile, enjoying the excitement around me during our family outing to the nighttime carnival, aware of the unfolding chaos as Max ran off.

grounded_facts: Esther tugs on Kate's arm and asks for cotton candy while Kate is distressed about Max's disappearance.
memories.memory_text: I tugged on Kate's arm and asked for cotton candy, but she said not now.

grounded_facts: Daniel informs Kate that he saw Esther let Max run off, triggering the confrontation.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Daniel saw me let Max run off while we were playing hide and seek.

grounded_facts: Daniel brings Max back to the group, reuniting her with Kate.
memories.memory_text: I saw Daniel bring Max back to the group and return her to Kate.

grounded_facts: John accuses Esther of lying after Daniel reveals she let Max run off intentionally.
memories.memory_text: John accused me of lying after Daniel said I let Max go, questioning whether I had been holding her hand like I was supposed to.

grounded_facts: After being confronted, Esther gives Daniel a hateful look through her tears.
memories.memory_text: I gave Daniel a hateful look through my tears after he told them what he saw.

grounded_facts: The family prepares to leave for school in the morning.
memories.memory_text: I remember how we all piled into the minivan that morning, getting ready for school like any other day.

grounded_facts: Esther pretends to find a baggie of weed and presents it as evidence against Daniel.
Esther secretly drops a plastic baggie of weed behind Daniel and pretends to discover it, framing him.
memories.memory_text: I dropped the plastic baggie behind Daniel and pretended to find it, then showed it to Kate, saying, 'What's this?' like I was surprised.

grounded_facts: John verbally excludes Daniel from the treehouse by declaring it off-limits.
memories.memory_text: I heard John say the treehouse was off limits, and he was talking to Daniel, so I knew Daniel wasn't allowed in anymore.

grounded_facts: Esther takes John's hand and walks inside the house with him, showing closeness.
memories.memory_text: I took John's hand and walked inside the house with him.

grounded_facts: John secures the treehouse door with a hasp and padlock, then keeps the key, restricting access.
memories.memory_text: I saw John use a power drill to attach a hasp to the treehouse door and put a padlock on it, and then I took his hand and went inside the house with him.

grounded_facts: Esther comments that Joyce's clothing is immodest and expresses disapproval.
memories.memory_text: I told Kate that Joyce's clothing is immodest and I don't understand why my dad likes her so much.

grounded_facts: Esther tells Kate that her father smiles at and talks to Joyce Patterson, and that Joyce wants him to come over to her house, causing Kate visible disturbance.
memories.memory_text: I told Kate that my father always smiles at Joyce and talks to her, and that Joyce wants him to come over to her house, which made her look upset.

grounded_facts: Kate drives Esther from home to the dentist's office, during which Esther makes a disturbing revelation about her father and Joyce Patterson.
memories.memory_text: I remember riding with Kate to the dentist, and during the drive, I told her about my dad smiling at Joyce and how she wants him to come over.

grounded_facts: Esther refuses to get out of the minivan at the dentist's office, leading to a tense confrontation with Kate before eventually complying.
memories.memory_text: I stayed in the minivan because I don't like the dentist, and even though I said I wasn't going, I eventually did as I was told when Kate insisted.

grounded_facts: Kate commands Esther to get out of the minivan at the dentist's office after Esther refuses.
memories.memory_text: I heard Kate command me to get out of the minivan right away after I refused to leave.

grounded_facts: Kate and Esther arrive at the dentist's office, where Esther resists getting out of the car before ultimately complying.
memories.memory_text: When we got to the dentist, I didn't want to get out of the car because I don't like it there, but Kate told me to get out right now, so I did.

grounded_facts: The dentist verbally prompts Esther to open her mouth wider for the examination.
memories.memory_text: The dentist kept telling me to open wide and then said 'that a girl, little wider,' but I didn't want to.

grounded_facts: Esther initially keeps her mouth tightly shut and looks at the ceiling, showing anxiety and reluctance to cooperate.
memories.memory_text: I kept my mouth tightly shut and looked at the ceiling because I was so anxious, but then I opened it a bit more when he leaned in.

grounded_facts: Esther suddenly bites down hard on the dentist's fingers during the examination, drawing blood and causing injury.
memories.memory_text: I suddenly bit down hard on the dentist's fingers when he leaned in to look, feeling the blood and locking on like I had to fight back.

grounded_facts: A scheduled dental check-up for Esther after a two-year gap, involving the dentist and hygienist preparing and attempting to examine her teeth.
memories.memory_text: I remember they said I hadn't had a check-up in two years, and then the hygienist held me down while the dentist tried to pry my mouth open.

grounded_facts: The hygienist addresses Kate as 'Mrs. Coleman', incorrectly identifying her, which causes confusion.
Kate is called by the hygienist but appears confused, indicating she did not expect to be addressed as Mrs. Coleman.
memories.memory_text: I heard the hygienist call out 'Mrs. Coleman?' and I gave her a confused look, because that’s not me and I didn’t know why she was calling me that.

grounded_facts: A scheduled visit to the dentist's office, where Kate is waiting to be seen.
memories.memory_text: I was at the dentist's office, waiting to be seen, just sitting there when everything started.

grounded_facts: Kate notices Esther standing behind the hygienist, smirking, suggesting intentional involvement in the misidentification.
Esther stands behind the hygienist and smirks at Kate, implying she orchestrated the misidentification.
memories.memory_text: I noticed I was being watched by Esther, who was standing behind the hygienist with a smirk on her face, and I realized she must have set it up.

grounded_facts: Kate is emotionally strained and encounters multiple alcohol-related visual stimuli while driving, which evoke strong internal temptation.
memories.memory_text: I was in the car with Kate when she stopped at a light next to a liquor store and some vodka ad at a bus shelter; I didn't notice her looking strained, and she drove off quickly without saying anything.

grounded_facts: Esther, eavesdropping from upstairs, hears that Sister Abigail wants to discuss her in person, leading to fear and anger.
Esther listens in on a private message meant for Kate and John, learning that Sister Abigail wants to discuss her in person, which triggers emotional distress.
memories.memory_text: I was standing at the top of the stairs and heard the message Sister Abigail left for Kate and John—she wants to discuss me in person, and I felt scared and angry, like I’m in trouble or being watched.

grounded_facts: Sister Abigail leaves a voicemail requesting Kate and John meet her in person to discuss Esther, indicating a serious concern.
Kate listens to a voicemail from Sister Abigail requesting an in-person meeting about Esther, which marks the beginning of new narrative tension.
memories.memory_text: I was at the top of the stairs when Kate played that message from Sister Abigail—I heard her say she needed to talk to Kate and John about me in person, and I could tell it was serious. I felt scared and angry, like they were all ganging up on me.

grounded_facts: A private nighttime conversation between Esther and Max about how to respond to the upcoming visit of a woman who might take Max away.
memories.memory_text: I remember sitting with Max on the bed late at night, just the two of us under the dim bedside light, signing quietly to each other.

grounded_facts: Esther suggests a plan to scare away the woman coming tomorrow, aiming to prevent her from taking Max back to the home.
memories.memory_text: I told Max the woman is coming tomorrow, and when she said she was afraid of losing me to the home, I said we had to scare her away—and I asked if she would help me.

grounded_facts: Esther asks Max to join her in a plan to scare away the visiting woman, strengthening their alliance.
memories.memory_text: I asked Max to join me in scaring the woman away, and when she nodded anxiously, I knew we were in this together and our bond was stronger.

grounded_facts: Esther and Max sneak into John's den at night to search for the key to the treehouse.
memories.memory_text: I sneaked into John's den with Max at night, and I told her to look for the key to the treehouse.

grounded_facts: Max discovers a ring of keys in a keepsake chest while searching John's den.
memories.memory_text: I saw Max open a keepsake chest and find several keys on a ring, and she showed them to me.

grounded_facts: Esther uses one of the found keys to unlock a dark plastic case secured with padlocks.
memories.memory_text: I used one of the keys I found to unlock the dark plastic case, and I heard a click when it opened.

grounded_facts: Esther discovers a revolver and box of ammunition inside the unlocked case.
memories.memory_text: I saw a shiny revolver and a box of ammunition inside the case, and I carefully picked up the gun to look at it.

grounded_facts: Esther loads a single bullet into the revolver, spins the cylinder, and points it at Max.
memories.memory_text: I picked up the gun, loaded a single bullet, spun the cylinder, and pointed it at Max.

grounded_facts: Esther points a loaded revolver at Max and asks if she wants to play, creating a moment of intense fear.
memories.memory_text: I pointed the loaded revolver at Max and asked her if she wanted to play, seeing the fear in her eyes.

grounded_facts: Esther decides not to proceed with the dangerous game after seeing Max's fear.
memories.memory_text: I saw how afraid Max was, and I decided we shouldn't play the game after all—not yet.

grounded_facts: Esther secretly listens to Sister Abigail's revelations about her and then leaves unnoticed.
memories.memory_text: I overheard Sister Abigail talking about me and realized she's been suspicious all along, so I slipped away without being seen.

grounded_facts: A meeting in the living room where Sister Abigail discusses Esther's background and behavioral concerns with Kate and John.
Sister Abigail admits she had deeper concerns about Esther from the beginning, beyond suspected abuse, including a sense of profound damage and repeated presence during incidents of harm.
memories.memory_text: I overheard Sister Abigail talking to Kate and John in the living room, and I learned she's had deep concerns about me from the beginning—not just about abuse, but that she thinks I'm profoundly damaged and connected to harmful events.

grounded_facts: Sister Abigail explains that a severely character-disturbed child can display two faces: one for manipulation and one as their true, hidden self.
memories.memory_text: I remember Sister Abigail explaining that a severely disturbed child can have two faces—one shown to the world to get what they want, and the other, their true self, hidden underneath.

grounded_facts: Max is seated on her bed, dressed and holding her backpack, showing signs of anxiety while waiting for someone or something.
memories.memory_text: I saw Max sitting on her bed, wearing her jacket and holding her 'Bello. Kitty' backpack, looking anxious while waiting.

grounded_facts: Esther enters Max's bedroom and tells her 'Let's go,' signaling the initiation of a shared activity or movement.
memories.memory_text: I entered Max's bedroom and told her, 'Let's go,' to start our movement together.

grounded_facts: A coordinated moment when Max and Esther begin to leave Max's bedroom, indicating the start of an outing or journey.
memories.memory_text: I remember the moment Max and I began to leave her bedroom together, right after I told her it was time to go.

grounded_facts: Esther and Max hide behind the abutment of the bridge to avoid being seen.
memories.memory_text: I hid behind the bridge abutment with Max to avoid being seen.

grounded_facts: Esther gives Max a reassuring smile and tells her everything will be fine before the ambush.
memories.memory_text: I gave Max a reassuring smile and told her it was going to be fine, just to wave her arms and make sure Sister Abigail stopped.

grounded_facts: Esther pushes Max onto the road in front of Sister Abigail's approaching car, causing a near-fatal accident.
memories.memory_text: I pushed Max into the road in front of Sister Abigail's car, and I saw her stumble and fall just as the tires squealed and the car stopped inches from her.

grounded_facts: Sister Abigail recognizes Max after the fall and speaks her name in shock.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sister Abigail gasp Max's name in shock after the fall, like she recognized her.

grounded_facts: Esther takes cash, credit cards, and rosary beads from Sister Abigail's purse after the attack.
memories.memory_text: I took the cash, credit cards, and rosary beads from Sister Abigail's purse after the attack.

grounded_facts: After initially incapacitating her, Esther uses a claw hammer to kill Sister Abigail with multiple blows to the head.
memories.memory_text: I used the claw hammer to hit Sister Abigail in the head, again and again, until she stopped moving.

grounded_facts: After the murder, Esther checks whether Max has blood on her and confirms she does not.
memories.memory_text: I asked Max if she got any blood on her, and I saw her shake her head, still shivering.

grounded_facts: Esther and Max ambush Sister Abigail on a private road, leading to her murder and robbery.
memories.memory_text: After the car stopped, I heard the car approaching, took the cash and cards from Sister Abigail's purse, and helped move her body before kicking it down the embankment and covering it with leaves.

grounded_facts: Esther and Max drag Sister Abigail's body off the road and cover it with leaves to conceal the crime.
memories.memory_text: I helped Max drag Sister Abigail's body off the road and covered it with leaves to hide it.

grounded_facts: Esther hides Max's 'Hello Kitty' backpack under the floorboard in the treehouse, a location previously used by Daniel to hide his weed.
memories.memory_text: I hid Max's 'Hello Kitty' backpack under the loose floorboard in the treehouse, the same spot Daniel used for his weed.

grounded_facts: A tense encounter between Esther and Max in the treehouse, involving threats, concealment, and emotional manipulation following the death of Sister Abigail.
memories.memory_text: I remember the tension in the treehouse after Sister Abigail died—Max was dazed in the corner, I was in my clean dress, and I made sure he understood he couldn't tell anyone what I did.

grounded_facts: Esther warns Max that if he reveals her actions, he will also face consequences, specifically being sent to jail for his role in burying Sister Abigail.
Esther tells Max that he will be punished legally if he reports her, making him complicit.
memories.memory_text: I told Max that if he revealed my actions, he’d face consequences too—I made it clear they’d send him to jail for helping me bury her, so he’d be punished just as much as me.

grounded_facts: After Max starts crying, Esther moves closer and comforts him, shifting from threat to reassurance.
Esther physically moves closer and comforts Max after he begins crying, reinforcing their emotional bond.
memories.memory_text: I moved closer to Max and comforted him when he started crying, feeling the shift from fear to reassurance between us.

grounded_facts: Esther claims Sister Abigail wanted to take her away, framing the murder as necessary to preserve their relationship.
Esther tells Max that they can now be together forever, implying that Sister Abigail's removal was necessary to preserve their relationship.
memories.memory_text: I told Max that Sister Abigail wanted to take me away from him, and that now we can be together forever, just the two of us.

grounded_facts: The vendor hands a SpongeBob popsicle to Esther, who smiles and walks away.
memories.memory_text: I smiled at the vendor when he handed me the SpongeBob popsicle, and then I walked away.

grounded_facts: Esther secretly discards a plastic grocery bag containing a bloody hammer and Abigail's belongings into the homeless man's shopping cart in the park.
Esther deliberately places the bag with the bloody hammer and Abigail's things into the homeless man's shopping cart without his knowledge.
memories.memory_text: I saw the homeless man across the park and casually walked over, then I quietly put the bag with the bloody hammer and Abigail's things into his shopping cart without him noticing.

grounded_facts: Esther visits the park, interacts with a vendor, receives a popsicle, and covertly disposes of evidence.
memories.memory_text: I locked the treehouse and looked around carefully before going to the vendor, who handed me a SpongeBob popsicle; I smiled at him and walked away, then saw the homeless man across the park and casually went over, quietly tossing the incriminating bag into his shopping cart without stopping.

grounded_facts: Rate and John hear Esther humming upstairs and exchange a disturbed look.
memories.memory_text: I was humming upstairs while in the bath, and though I couldn't see them, I later realized Rate and John must have heard me and exchanged a disturbed look.

grounded_facts: Esther takes a bath in which she scrubs herself while humming, during which the camera reveals her scars.
memories.memory_text: I took a bath, humming to myself as I scrubbed under my fingernails, the water turning faintly red around me.

grounded_facts: During her bath, it is revealed that Esther has scars from self-harm on her neck and wrists, previously covered by black velvet ribbons.
memories.memory_text: I remember taking off my black velvet ribbons during my bath, and knowing that the scars on my neck and wrists were finally visible.

grounded_facts: After Daniel leaves the den, Esther emerges from the shadows in the hallway and glares at him angrily.
memories.memory_text: I emerged from the shadows in the hallway and glared at Daniel angrily after he left the den.

grounded_facts: Due to extreme fear during Esther's threat, Daniel involuntarily urinates on the bed.
memories.memory_text: I noticed the damp spot spreading through the bedspread and realized Daniel must have wet himself out of fear, though I didn't see it happen.

grounded_facts: After noticing the urine stain on the bedspread, Esther points out Daniel's incontinence and grins, deepening his humiliation.
memories.memory_text: I saw the stain on the bed and grinned, then told Daniel, 'You pissed yourself,' watching his face twist with shame.

grounded_facts: Esther sneaks into Daniel's bedroom at night, restrains him by his hair, holds scissors to his eye and then between his legs, and threatens to castrate him if he reveals what he saw.
Esther enters Daniel's bedroom at night while he is asleep, turns on the light, and confronts him with violence and threats.
Esther uses physical intimidation and explicit violence (scissors) to threaten Daniel's genitals, warning him not to disclose what he saw.
memories.memory_text: I sneaked into Daniel's room at night while he was asleep, turned on the light, grabbed him by the hair, and held the scissors to his eye and then between his legs—I told him if he ever told anyone what he saw, I’d cut his little prick off, and I could see he was crying, terrified, so I knew he’d stay quiet.

grounded_facts: A meeting between Esther and Dr. Browning takes place in the office.
memories.memory_text: I was in Dr. Browning's office for our meeting, which I remember clearly.

grounded_facts: Esther finishes her conversation with Dr. Browning and expresses hope for friendship.
Esther tells Dr. Browning she hopes they can be friends.
memories.memory_text: I finished talking with Dr. Browning and told him I hoped we could be friends.

grounded_facts: Esther asks the Secretary for permission to use the restroom.
memories.memory_text: I fidgeted and asked the Secretary, 'May I go to the restroom?' because I really needed to go.

grounded_facts: Dr. Browning explicitly states that Esther is not to blame for the tension in the relationship with Kate.
memories.memory_text: I remember Dr. Browning saying that I'm not to blame for the tension with Kate, that it's not my fault.

grounded_facts: After Dr. Browning's revelations, Kate turns to John in shock, seeking support or confirmation.
memories.memory_text: I saw Kate turn to John in shock after Dr. Browning spoke, looking for support, but he didn't reassure her and instead said I'm not to blame for what's happening between them.

grounded_facts: Esther has a fit of rage and distress in the restroom stall, pounding the walls and shouting incoherently.
memories.memory_text: I remember clutching my head and rocking back and forth in the stall, overwhelmed by rage and distress after what Dr. Browning said.

grounded_facts: Esther mutters angrily about Kate, calling her a 'coaksucking bitch' and claiming she knows nothing.
memories.memory_text: I muttered to myself that Kate was a 'coaksucking bitch' and didn't know anything—I needed to say it out loud, even if just in the stall.

grounded_facts: After her breakdown, Esther exits the stall and ignores a woman who likely overheard her outburst.
memories.memory_text: I composed myself after my fit and walked out of the stall, seeing a woman at the sink who was looking at me warily—she probably heard everything—but I held my head high and walked right by her without speaking.

grounded_facts: A domestic moment in the family room where multiple family members are engaged in separate activities before being interrupted by Esther's entrance and demand.
memories.memory_text: I remember walking in holding Max's hand while Daniel was sitting in the recliner and Kate was busy online, everyone doing their own thing before I made our move.

grounded_facts: Esther directly confronts Daniel to take the recliner, using a commanding tone and nonverbal cue, leading to Daniel's abrupt departure.
memories.memory_text: I stood with Max and told Daniel we wanted to sit in the recliner, using a firm tone and gesture, and I saw him react right away by turning off his game and getting up.

grounded_facts: Daniel turns off his game and leaves the recliner after Esther asserts her and Max's claim to the chair.
memories.memory_text: I saw Daniel brusquely turn off his game and get out of the recliner, then he ignored me and stomped upstairs, leaving the chair for us.

grounded_facts: John and Kate discuss their concerns about Esther, including past warnings from Sister Abigail and the possibility of contacting the Russian orphanage director.
memories.memory_text: I was painting when I heard John and Kate talking about me, saying Sister Abigail had warned them and wondering if the director of the orphanage in Russia thought something was wrong too.

grounded_facts: After hesitation, John consents to Kate's proposal to contact the Russian orphanage director to verify whether there were prior concerns about Esther.
memories.memory_text: I saw John hesitate, but then he agreed to let Kate contact the orphanage director to find out more about me.

grounded_facts: After overhearing the conversation, Esther throws her painting across the room, expressing rage at the threat of exposure.
memories.memory_text: I overheard them talking about me, and I couldn't hold back—I threw my painting across the room in rage.

grounded_facts: Esther overhears John and Kate discussing concerns from Sister Abigail and the Russian orphanage director about her, which triggers her emotional reaction.
memories.memory_text: When I realized they were going to investigate me, I stopped painting and listened, and then I got so angry I threw my painting across the room.

grounded_facts: Esther watches John silently through the mirror reflection before speaking, suggesting calculation or scrutiny.
memories.memory_text: I watched John in the mirror while he shaved, and he saw me looking, so I smiled at him.

grounded_facts: Esther asks John to take her to school, presenting a seemingly innocent request while having just overheard damaging conversation.
memories.memory_text: I asked John to take me to school today, right after I heard him talking about getting a second opinion.

grounded_facts: Esther reveals she hates school and feels unliked, showing emotional distress.
Esther tells John she hates school and feels unliked.
memories.memory_text: I told John how much I hate school and that nobody likes me there, because I really don't feel like anyone ever does.

grounded_facts: John suggests calling in sick and going to the zoo instead of school.
John responds to Esther's sadness by offering to skip school and go to the zoo.
memories.memory_text: John told me we could skip school and go to the zoo instead—he said he’d call in sick and asked what I thought.

grounded_facts: A conversation in the car where Esther expresses her unwillingness to attend school and John responds with an alternative plan.
memories.memory_text: I remember being in the car with John, telling him I didn’t want to go to school, and then we talked about going to the zoo instead.

grounded_facts: Parents, including Kate, arrive at Me Tary School in the morning to drop off their children.
memories.memory_text: I remember the morning when parents were dropping us off at Me Tary School, and Kate arrived in her car at the start of the long line.

grounded_facts: Kate asks Daniel whether Esther makes them feel uncomfortable or has ever hurt them, attempting to elicit disclosure.
memories.memory_text: I heard Kate ask Daniel and Max whether I ever made them feel uncomfortable or had hurt them, like she was trying to get them to say something about me.

grounded_facts: Daniel hesitates when Kate tries to talk to him, shows visible discomfort when asked about Esther, and quickly leaves without answering her questions.
memories.memory_text: I saw Daniel freeze and look nervous when Kate asked him about me, and even though he started to say something, he shut down, said he had to go, and ran off without answering.

grounded_facts: Esther voices her doubt that Mommy loves her as much as her biological children due to being adopted, revealing emotional vulnerability.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Esther voices her doubt that Mommy loves her as much as her biological children due to being adopted, revealing emotional vulnerability.

grounded_facts: Esther physically and verbally seeks comfort from John by expressing her fear of not being loved by Mommy.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Esther physically and verbally seeks comfort from John by expressing her fear of not being loved by Mommy.

grounded_facts: John affirms Esther's equal status in the family and insists she is fully loved despite being adopted.
John explicitly affirms that Esther is equally loved and part of the family, countering her insecurity.
memories.memory_text: John told me I am just as much a part of the family as Danny and Max, and that Mommy doesn't love me any less because I'm adopted.

grounded_facts: John and Esther visit the zoo together, walking by the lion exhibit and engaging in a meaningful conversation.
memories.memory_text: I remember that John and Esther visit the zoo together, walking by the lion exhibit and engaging in a meaningful conversation.

grounded_facts: John advises Esther to do something special for Mommy to demonstrate her worth and improve their relationship.
John suggests Esther do something special for Mommy to show her goodness and improve their relationship.
memories.memory_text: John told me I should do something special for Mommy so she can see what a good girl I am, and I think that might help us get closer.

grounded_facts: John confronts Kate for hurting Esther after seeing her cry.
memories.memory_text: I saw John look at me and then shout at Kate, and I think he must have thought she hurt me when she grabbed my wrist.

grounded_facts: Esther picks the orchid that was a memorial plant, presenting it as a surprise to Kate.
memories.memory_text: I picked the orchid that was a memorial plant and hid it behind my back, smiling as I brought it to Mommy as a surprise.

grounded_facts: Esther presents the picked orchid as a gift to Kate, intending to please her.
memories.memory_text: I told Mommy I had a special surprise for her and said I picked the flower just for her, wanting so much to make her happy.

grounded_facts: Kate forcibly grabs Esther's wrist to stop her from moving away with the orchid, causing Esther pain.
memories.memory_text: I was pulling away with the orchid when Kate suddenly grabbed my wrist, and it hurt so much I dropped the flower and cried out.

grounded_facts: A domestic family moment after dinner, involving shared chores and an unexpected emotional incident.
memories.memory_text: After dinner, I was excited to give Mommy the flower, but when she grabbed my wrist, I shrieked in pain and ran from the room, crying and clutching my wrist.

grounded_facts: The memorial orchid is dropped and physically destroyed during the struggle.
memories.memory_text: I remember the orchid falling to the floor during the struggle, and then Kate picking it up—its petals were crushed and it was ruined.

grounded_facts: John provides emotional support to Esther, who is crying on the sofa.
John comforts Esther while she is crying.
memories.memory_text: I was crying on the sofa and I remember John comforting me, holding me close as I leaned into him.

grounded_facts: John shoots an angry look at Kate as she looks in on them.
John directs an angry look toward Kate as she looks in on them.
memories.memory_text: I saw John shoot an angry look toward Kate as she looked in on us, and I could feel the tension in the room.

grounded_facts: Esther places her injured wrist into a vice and gradually tightens it, enduring intense pain as a form of self-treatment or testing.
Esther enters the work shed at night and performs a painful self-administered procedure on her injured wrist.
memories.memory_text: I slipped into the work shed at night, went to the bench, and placed my injured wrist—where Rate grabbed me—into the vice, wrapping it with rags first; I bit down on a screwdriver and slowly tightened the vice, enduring the pain as part of my own treatment.

grounded_facts: Esther calls out to her father in pain and fear, seeking immediate help for her injured arm.
memories.memory_text: I called out to my father in pain and fear, shouting 'Daddy! Daddy!' because my arm hurt and I needed immediate help.

grounded_facts: Esther wakes up in pain and calls out for her father, reporting that her arm hurts.
memories.memory_text: I woke up suddenly because my arm was hurting, and I called out for my father, needing him to come quickly.

grounded_facts: A nighttime incident where Esther summons her father for arm pain, leading to an urgent examination.
memories.memory_text: I remember waking up in pain, calling my dad for help, and then seeing him come into my room in his pajamas and turn on the bedside lamp to examine my injured arm.

grounded_facts: John examines Esther's arm and observes that her wrist is severely discolored and appears injured.
John inspects Esther's arm after she reveals bruising, responding to her report of pain.
memories.memory_text: I showed my father the bruising on my arm because it hurt, and I remember him looking closely at it, seeing how badly discolored my wrist was.

memories.memory_text: I remember the social worker taking pictures of my bruises while I sat in the hospital gown, still wearing my black ribbons.

memories.memory_text: I was told the doctor said I had a hairline fracture in my radius after they looked at the x-ray.

memories.memory_text: I heard the doctor say they had to file a report with Child Protective Services and that someone would come to our house later.

memories.memory_text: I was there when they brought me to the emergency room and checked my arm, took pictures, put me in a cast, and talked to my parents about what would happen next.

memories.memory_text: I remember coming home late, still in my pajamas with my coat on, and seeing Max asleep in John's arms.

memories.memory_text: I crept into the bedroom and watched John sleep before quietly climbing into bed beside him, curling up close without waking him.

memories.memory_text: I brought my stack of paintings to school, including one I made especially for Mrs. Grosse, and I hope she likes them.

memories.memory_text: Show-and-tell is our school event where we get to share something special with the class, and I'm getting ready to present my paintings.

memories.memory_text: I shared how excited I was about my paintings and show-and-tell, but nobody in my family responded—I noticed Kate was blocking me out.

memories.memory_text: I dropped my paintings in the gutter and they started blowing away, and right away Kate accused me, saying, 'You dropped them on purpose,' even though I didn't mean to.

memories.memory_text: I smiled at Kate right after I released the parking brake, and I saw her give me a dirty look in response.

memories.memory_text: I deliberately released the parking brake and put the van in neutral, knowing it would start rolling with Max still inside.

memories.memory_text: I struggled to get out of the van that morning, my wrist cast making it hard to hold onto my paintings, and I remember Kate dropping Daniel and me off at elementary school.

memories.memory_text: I noticed Daniel pointing something out to Kate, but I didn't hear what he said, so I'm not sure if he realized I caused the van to roll.

memories.memory_text: I was told that Kate wanted to drink the wine and struggled not to, but she claimed she didn't actually drink it.

memories.memory_text: I saw Dr. Browning tell Kate she had an opening at a rehab clinic for relapsed alcoholics, and I watched her argue with John about it before Kate said, 'I'm not going to rehab.'

grounded_facts: John presents the hidden wine bottle to prove Kate's dishonesty about her relapse.
John produces the wine bottle Kate hid in her closet, proving she acquired alcohol and did not fully disclose it.
memories.memory_text: I saw John show the wine bottle he found in Kate's closet, and I knew it proved she had been hiding the truth about drinking.

memories.memory_text: I whispered to Max that I'd kill her if she told, making sure she knew I meant it.

grounded_facts: Max and Esther secretly observe the adults' argument and are discovered only after Esther threatens Max.
memories.memory_text: I was with Max, watching the adults argue, and when he started crying, I made sure he stayed quiet until Dr. Browning noticed us and told us to go watch TV.

grounded_facts: After learning from Max that Esther caused the van to roll, Daniel resolves that they must tell their parents.
memories.memory_text: I remember Daniel asking Max if I did something to the van, and seeing him piece it together when she couldn't sign fast enough—he must have suspected I caused it to roll, especially after he said he saw me jump out before it started moving.

grounded_facts: As he leaves, Daniel signs to Max that everything will be all right, attempting to calm her fear.
memories.memory_text: I saw Daniel pause at the door and sign to Max that everything would be all right, as if trying to calm her down before he left.

grounded_facts: Daniel hurries back to his room and closes the door, indicating urgency or avoidance.
memories.memory_text: I saw Daniel hurry back to his room and shut the door right after I came out of the bathroom.

grounded_facts: Esther notices Daniel rushing into his room and closing the door, which triggers her suspicion.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Daniel rushing into his room and closing the door, and it made me feel suspicious.

grounded_facts: Kate tries to leave the house at night with an overnight bag without waking Max, indicating a planned escape or departure.
memories.memory_text: I saw Kate creeping through the dark hallway with an overnight bag, trying not to make noise, and I watched her open Max's bedroom door and slip inside.

grounded_facts: Esther discloses that she has read Kate's private journal, including traumatic details about her stillbirth and drinking problem, using it to emotionally attack Kate.
memories.memory_text: I held up Kate's journal and told her I found it weeks ago, reading about her stillbirth and drinking—how she carried her dead baby for sixteen days, feeling phantom kicks like a missing limb. I wanted her to know I saw all her pain and secrets.

grounded_facts: Esther mocks Kate's alcoholism and implies she endangered her children, citing her journal as evidence.
memories.memory_text: I mocked Kate for passing out drunk and told her the first step is admitting she has a problem, calling her a nasty, smelly drunk who endangered her children—all from what I read in her journal.

grounded_facts: Esther reveals that her father sexually abused her from infancy and claims it was meant to make her strong, contrasting her resilience with Kate's perceived weakness.
memories.memory_text: I told Kate that my father started abusing me when I was in diapers and that I don't remember a time when he wasn't doing it to me, and I made it clear I don't want her pity because he did it to make me strong so I wouldn't end up weak and pathetic like her.

grounded_facts: Esther dismisses Kate's grief over her stillborn daughter, framing her own abuse as a greater, formative suffering that Kate cannot understand.
memories.memory_text: I dismissed Kate's grief over losing her stillborn daughter, telling her that her suffering could have made her stronger but instead she just hides behind therapy, pills, and booze, and I told her she doesn't deserve John's support.

grounded_facts: Kate physically blocks Esther from leaving, showing intent to escalate, but stops short of violence and retrieves her journal instead.
memories.memory_text: I stood up to leave, but Kate blocked my path, so I asked her if she was going to hit me, and she looked like she wanted to—but then she didn't, and just held out her hand for the journal.

grounded_facts: After being emotionally attacked, Kate demands her journal back and Esther returns it; Kate allows Esther to leave.
memories.memory_text: I gave Kate her journal back with a smile, and she stepped aside, letting me leave while she just glared after me.

grounded_facts: A tense, private encounter between Kate and Esther in Max's bedroom late at night, involving emotional revelations and power struggles.
memories.memory_text: I turned on the light in Max's room while Kate was there, told her not to wake Max, and shared what I knew about carrying a dead baby inside me—how I felt her kick even after she died. I saw Kate tremble with rage, handed her the journal, and left while she glared at me.

grounded_facts: A game is being played in the family room involving Doris and the kids, where Doris suggests a solution to the mystery game.
memories.memory_text: I was in the family room when Doris started playing the game with us kids.

grounded_facts: Doris publicly declares her accusation in the game, naming Professor Plum, the Conservatory, and the candlestick.
memories.memory_text: I heard Doris say, 'I say Professor Plum did it in the Conservatory with the candlestick,' and I knew she was making her accusation.

grounded_facts: Kate examines Esther's life book and notices the first page has been torn out and Esther's face has been cut out from a family photo, suggesting self-insertion or identity distortion.
memories.memory_text: I remember that my life book was tampered with—the first page torn out and my face cut from a family photo, as if someone tried to erase me or reshape who I am.

grounded_facts: Kate finds the missing page from Esther's life book inside a hidden Bible, where Esther has replaced Kate's face with her own in a wedding photo of Kate and John, indicating identification or replacement fantasy.
memories.memory_text: I put the missing life book page in the Bible with my face pasted over hers in the wedding photo, so she saw it when she looked through the pictures.

grounded_facts: Kate discovers a Bible concealed inside a stuffed doll after knocking it over during her search of Esther's room.
memories.memory_text: I remember hiding the Bible inside the doll’s stuffing, and I saw that Kate knocked it over and found it when she lifted the dress.

grounded_facts: Kate notices the Bible is written in a foreign language and finds an ink stamp on the inside cover with the words 'seamne inatituut', suggesting a possible institutional origin.
memories.memory_text: I saw that the Bible was in a foreign language, and there was an ink stamp on the inside cover with the words 'seamne inatituut'—it looked like it came from some kind of institution.

grounded_facts: Daniel finds Max's backpack in the treehouse containing Esther's blood-stained dress, confirming physical evidence linking her to a violent act.
memories.memory_text: I saw Daniel pull my blood-stained dress from Max's backpack in the treehouse, and I knew he had found the proof.

grounded_facts: Esther manipulates Daniel by warning that exposing her will also implicate Max, attempting to deter him from revealing the truth.
memories.memory_text: I told Daniel that Max was just as guilty as I was, and warned him they wouldn't just be coming for me if he exposed the truth.

grounded_facts: Daniel directly accuses Esther of a crime and threatens to expose her to his mother.
memories.memory_text: Daniel accused me directly, saying he was going to tell his mother what I did and that I'd pay for it.

grounded_facts: Esther sets fire to the treehouse floor, blocking Daniel's escape and trapping him inside.
memories.memory_text: I set the floor on fire with the lighter fluid and matches, trapping Daniel inside by blocking the door.

grounded_facts: A direct confrontation between Daniel and Esther in the treehouse, culminating in violence and entrapment.
memories.memory_text: I stood in the doorway behind Daniel, holding the charcoal and lighter fluid behind my back before I moved to block him from the exit. I doused the floor with the fluid and lit a match, then dropped it to ignite the liquid, creating a wall of fire between him and the door. I smiled at him as he realized he was trapped.

grounded_facts: Kate provides information about the Saarne Institute, specifying its name and location in Estonia.
memories.memory_text: I was told the place is called the Saarne Institute and it's in Estonia.

grounded_facts: A fire breaks out in the treehouse, threatening Daniel and drawing attention from Esther and Kate.
memories.memory_text: I climbed down from the treehouse and watched it burn, seeing the fire break out and spread quickly.

grounded_facts: Daniel repeatedly shouts for his mother while trapped in the burning treehouse.
memories.memory_text: I heard Daniel shouting for his mother, his voice desperate and panicked as he called out from inside the burning treehouse.

grounded_facts: Daniel is surrounded by flames and smoke inside the treehouse, struggling to escape as the fire intensifies.
memories.memory_text: I wasn't sure exactly what was happening inside, but from the flames and smoke I saw and the way Daniel was screaming, I thought he must be trapped and struggling to get out.

grounded_facts: Daniel loses his grip while hanging from the treehouse and falls to the ground, remaining motionless.
memories.memory_text: I walked over and crouched next to Daniel after he fell and lay motionless on the ground.

grounded_facts: Esther observes Daniel's fall with disappointment, indicating she wanted him dead.
memories.memory_text: I felt disappointed when I realized he was still alive after checking.

grounded_facts: A crisis unfolds at the treehouse involving Daniel's fall, Esther's violent intent, and the arrival of Kate and others.
memories.memory_text: I remember the whole moment at the treehouse—the fall, checking Daniel, feeling disappointed he was alive, and preparing to kill him with the rock before everything escalated.

grounded_facts: After confirming Daniel is alive, Esther becomes disappointed and picks up a heavy rock, intending to crush his skull.
memories.memory_text: I touched his neck to check his pulse, then looked around and picked up a heavy rock, lifting it over my head because I intended to crush his skull.

grounded_facts: Max rushes in and knocks the rock from Esther's hands, preventing her from attacking Daniel.
memories.memory_text: I was about to strike Daniel with the rock when Max rushed in and knocked it from my hands, and I whirled on him, eyes flashing with rage.

grounded_facts: Kate sees Esther watching her warily and responds with a look of pure hate.
memories.memory_text: I saw Kate catch me watching her warily, and she glared at me with pure hate.

Doris offers Esther the opportunity to ride in the ambulance with Daniel.
memories.memory_text: I was offered a chance to ride in the ambulance with Daniel, Doris said I could come along.

grounded_facts: Kate asserts that she will not allow Esther out of her sight, rejecting Doris's offer.
Kate declares she will not let Esther out of her sight, overriding Doris's offer.
memories.memory_text: I heard Kate say she wouldn't let me out of her sight, so I knew I wasn't allowed to go with Doris and Daniel.

memories.memory_text: I heard Kate ask if the patient would be able to tell them what happened.

memories.memory_text: I remember Dr. Rajan saying it was unknown what the patient would remember when he woke up.

memories.memory_text: I asked Doris for a dollar for the pop machine, smiling like I really wanted a drink, but as soon as I was out of sight, I pocketed the money and slipped away—I didn't need a soda, I just needed to get away.

grounded_facts: Daniel briefly regains consciousness and sees Esther looming over him just before she attempts to suffocate him.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Daniel briefly regains consciousness and sees Esther looming over him just before she attempts to suffocate him.

memories.memory_text: I remember that Esther straddles Daniel and uses a pillow to smother him while he is immobilized by traction.

memories.memory_text: I put the heart rate monitor back on Daniel's finger, and I saw it register a flatline.

memories.memory_text: I saw that Daniel had stopped moving completely, as if his body had gone still forever.

memories.memory_text: I gently repositioned the pillow under Daniel's head after he stopped struggling.

memories.memory_text: I heard someone announce a code ninety-nine for the ICU and saw Dr. Rajan run past quickly, responding to the emergency.

memories.memory_text: I felt the slap hit me hard, and when I touched my mouth, I realized I was bleeding.

memories.memory_text: I remember that John responds to Esther's cry by picking her up and holding her.

memories.memory_text: I remember that After being slapped, Esther touches her bleeding mouth, lies in shock, then cries out for her father and is comforted by John.

memories.memory_text: I remember that After being struck, Esther cries out for her father and is comforted by John.

memories.memory_text: I saw Dr. Rajan and the orderlies overpower Kate when she was screaming and fighting; they held her down and injected her with a sedative, and then she went limp in their arms.

Kate confronts Esther with intense anger, accusing her of harming someone.
memories.memory_text: I was in the waiting room when Kate stormed in, furious, and started screaming at me, demanding to know what I did to her baby before she slapped me across the face, and I remember everyone staring in horror as orderlies and Dr. Rajan stepped in to stop her.

grounded_facts: After a failed attempt to call out, Kate blacks out, the last image being Esther's devious smile.
memories.memory_text: I tried to call out but didn't have the strength, and I remember fighting to stay awake before I blacked out, with Esther's devious smile being the last thing I saw.

grounded_facts: Before blacking out, Kate sees Esther's devious smile, interpreted as a menacing sign.
memories.memory_text: I saw Esther's devious smile just before I blacked out, and it felt like a menacing sign.

grounded_facts: Esther tells Max she is thinking about Daniel, making her uncomfortable.
memories.memory_text: I told Max she was thinking about Daniel, and when I asked her if it was true, she reluctantly nodded.

grounded_facts: John and Esther tuck Max into bed and say goodnight.
memories.memory_text: I watched John tuck Max into bed, and then I joined him at her bedside to say goodnight.

grounded_facts: Esther secretly takes Max's hearing aid from her nightstand while kissing her goodnight.
memories.memory_text: As I kissed Max goodnight, I secretly reached out and took her hearing aid from the nightstand.

grounded_facts: Esther selects a ruffly dress and deliberately cuts off its ruffles while humming to herself.
memories.memory_text: I chose a ruffly dress, laid it on my bed, and carefully cut off the ruffles while humming to myself.

grounded_facts: Daniel has died, and his body has been removed from the ICU bed, leaving the space empty.
memories.memory_text: I noticed the bed where Daniel was lying is now empty, as if he was never there, and I kept humming my tune while the mother broke down in silence.

grounded_facts: Esther modifies her dress, removes ruffles and sleeves, styles her hair, and applies heavy makeup to create a mature, unsettling look blending childhood and adult glamour.
memories.memory_text: I changed my dress by taking off the ruffles and sleeves to make it look more grown-up, and I curled my hair and put on lots of makeup so I'd look like a real beauty queen.

grounded_facts: Esther smiles and says 'Hello, darling' to John in a manner that is warm but unsettling given her appearance and tone.
memories.memory_text: I smiled and said 'Hello, darling' to John, feeling just right in my frilly dress and curls.
